buildCommand: if [ -f "build/web/index.html" ]; then echo 'Using pre-built web bundle'; else if ! command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable /tmp/flutter-sdk; fi; export PATH="/tmp/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH"; flutter config --enable-web; flutter pub get; flutter build web --release; fi
